hotels.description: Styled after the ramparts of historic Galle Fort and set on a private stretch of Sri Lanka's southern coast, The Fortress Resort and Spa blends Dutch colonial heritage with contemporary design. The cobbled streets, Portuguese churches and colourful bazaars of Galle's old town are only 30 minutes by car, while the stilt fishermen of Koggala cast their lines just beyond the resort's shoreline. The experience here is unhurried and deeply considered. Senses Spa fuses traditional Ayurveda and Thai healing techniques, delivering a truly distinctive approach to wellness. Beyond the spa, a sweeping infinity pool faces the Indian Ocean, three dining venues span from authentic Sri Lankan to wood-fired pizza, and the beachfront provides a quietly spectacular setting for doing very little at all.
